title: Spreading a finite separable extension over a localization
statement: Let A be a Noetherian integral domain with fraction field K and let K'/K be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] that is finite-dimensional as a K-vector space [def-weil-vector-space-dimension] and separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. There is a nonzero c in A and a finite etale A[c^{-1}]-algebra A' [def-weil-etale-morphism] that is a domain with fraction field K'; consequently Spec(A') to Spec(A[c^{-1}]) is finite etale and surjective.

source.place: proof, finite-algebra calculation, spreading out the separable extension

proof.text: By the primitive-element theorem, choose alpha in K' with K'=K(alpha). Let f in K[T] be the monic minimal polynomial of alpha. It has positive degree, is irreducible, and is separable because K'/K is separable. The existing minimal-polynomial quotient isomorphism identifies K[T]/(f) with K' and sends T to alpha.

source.place: Fields, Lemma Tag 09GN and algebraic case of Tag 09G1

proof.text: Clear the finitely many denominators in the coefficients of f and in the coefficients of its derivative, and then invert one further nonzero element so that the discriminant of f is a unit. Thus for S=A[c^{-1}] the polynomial f lies in S[T], remains monic, and its derivative is a unit in S[T]/(f). The quotient A'=S[T]/(f) is finite free over S (basis 1,T,...,T^(deg f-1)), is a domain because it embeds into K' through T to alpha, and has fraction field K' because its localization at A\{0} is K[T]/(f) = K'.

source.place: Lemma Tag 00UB (standard etale construction), denominator-clearing calculation

proof.text: The algebra A' is the standard etale algebra S[T][1/f']/(f), since f' is invertible modulo f; hence Spec(A') to Spec(S) is etale by [lem-weil-pbc-standard-etale-monic-derivative], and it is finite because A' is finite free over S by Step 2. For surjectivity: the map S to A' is injective, since A' is free over S with a basis containing 1 (deg f >= 1), and it is integral, since A' is a finite S-module. By [pqf-lem-lying-over] every prime of S is the contraction of a prime of A', so Spec(A') to Spec(S) is surjective.

lean.statement: theorem exists_spread_finite_separable_extension (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] (L : Type w) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L] [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] : ∃ c : A, c ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ S : Subalgebra A L, IsLocalization.Away c S ∧ ∃ B : Subalgebra S L, Module.Finite S B ∧ Algebra.Etale S B ∧ IsFractionRing B L ∧ IsFinite (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S B))) ∧ Etale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S B))) ∧ Surjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S B)))
